yuja.pricing: Not stated on the homepage; the page links to a request-a-demo contact page.
notable: Customers named on the homepage include Tulane University, University of North Dakota and Santa Monica College

facts.fact: YuJa describes itself as a cloud-based provider of digital compliance and accessibility solutions for regulated sectors worldwide.
The homepage names a Lumina video platform for storing, managing and streaming media, alongside accessibility and proctoring products.
Pricing is not published on the homepage; the vendor page points to a request-a-demo contact form.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.what_it_is: An automation platform for building and governing AI workflows, agents and apps, connecting AI to over 9,000 apps.
zapier.pricing: No pricing page is linked; the homepage offers Start free (sign-up) and Talk to sales. No amounts shown.
notable: Homepage says it serves more than three million businesses
Homepage states SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR and CCPA compliance

facts.fact: Zapier describes itself as an automation platform for building and governing AI workflows, agents and apps.
The homepage says Zapier connects to 9,000+ apps and serves more than three million businesses.
The homepage offers Start free (sign-up) and Talk to sales, and shows no prices.

zbrush.name: ZBrush
zbrush.what_it_is: A digital sculpting application with a dynamic brush system, base mesh creation tools and remeshing, sold by Maxon.
zbrush.platforms: Desktop, ZBrush on iPad, Windows on Arm (per Maxon page)
zbrush.pricing: Sold as a subscription; every ZBrush subscription includes ZBrush on desktop and iPad with premium features, and Redshift rendering; prices not in the text captured.
notable: Maxon's ZBrush page lists free access to Redshift CPU as part of the subscription
ZBrush for iPad is part of the subscription

facts.fact: Maxon's ZBrush page describes a dynamic brush system, base mesh creation tools and remeshing for sculpting.
Maxon's ZBrush page says every ZBrush subscription includes ZBrush on desktop, iPad and Windows on Arm devices with premium features.
Maxon's ZBrush page lists free access to Redshift CPU and ZBrush Classroom as subscription inclusions.

zendesk.name: Zendesk
zendesk.what_it_is: An AI-first customer service platform with self-learning AI agents and the Zendesk Resolution Platform, per the vendor's home page.
zendesk.platforms: Email, messaging, live chat, phone, social media and help centers.
zendesk.pricing: 14 days free trial, no credit card required; eligible startups can get up to 2 years free; plan prices are not on the page, which links to plans and pricing.
notable: Logo wall includes Siemens, GitHub, Uber, Box, Vimeo and Tesco
Home page claims over 22,000 service teams and 80,000+ companies (vendor claims)

facts.fact: Zendesk's home page describes it as an AI-first service platform with self-learning AI agents and the Zendesk Resolution Platform.
Zendesk's home page offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
Zendesk's home page says eligible startups can get up to 2 years of Zendesk free.
Zendesk's home page lists channels including email, messaging, live chat, phone, social media and help centers.

zeppelin.name: Zeppelin
zeppelin.what_it_is: Zeppelin is a moderation bot for Discord.
zeppelin.pricing: No prices were readable; the premium page loads its content with JavaScript.
notable: Moderation bot for Discord, per the site title

facts.fact: The Zeppelin site is titled Zeppelin - Moderation bot for Discord.
The Zeppelin about page loads without readable text, so the feature list could not be read.
The Zeppelin premium page loads without readable text, so no prices could be read.

zoho-desk.name: Zoho Desk
zoho-desk.what_it_is: Zoho Desk is an AI-assisted helpdesk platform that brings customers, channels and contexts together for multi-channel customer service.
zoho-desk.pricing: Per-user plans billed annually: Express from INR 420, Professional INR 1,400 and Enterprise INR 2,400 per user per month, shown in rupees on the opened pricing page. A Free plan and free trials are listed.
notable: Pricing page displays prices in INR for the visitor's region
Trusted by more than 125,000 businesses worldwide, per the homepage

facts.fact: Zoho Desk is an AI helpdesk software that brings customer conversations from every channel into one workspace.
The Zoho Desk pricing page lists per-user per-month plans billed annually, with Express from INR 420, Professional from INR 1,400 and Enterprise from INR 2,400.
The Zoho Desk pricing page offers a Free plan, free trials for each paid plan, and a quote request option.

zoom-events-and-webinars.name: Zoom Events and Webinars
zoom-events-and-webinars.what_it_is: Zoom's platform for hosting one-to-many webinars and virtual events, from simple sessions to full broadcasts.
zoom-events-and-webinars.platforms: Web-based webinar and event platform (per vendor page)
zoom-events-and-webinars.pricing: Three plans (Webinars, Webinars Plus, Events) listed on the page; dollar amounts are not on the page and the vendor points to a separate events pricing page.
notable: Webinars plan is for up to 500 attendees, billed monthly or annually

facts.fact: Zoom Webinars is described as a platform for one-to-many presentations, from simple sessions to full broadcasts, with branding, production tools and analytics.
The page lists three plans: Webinars (up to 500 attendees), Webinars Plus (adds AI, on-demand video and pro production tools) and Events.
Dollar prices are not shown on the page; the vendor refers to a separate events pricing page for current rates.
The copyright notice on the page names Zoom Communications, Inc.

zulip.name: Zulip
zulip.what_it_is: An organized team chat app for distributed teams, available as managed Zulip Cloud or as 100% open-source self-hosted software.
zulip.platforms: Web, desktop and mobile apps; Zulip Cloud or self-hosting
zulip.pricing: A free plan (free for many organizations and eligible open-source projects); paid Zulip Cloud plans at $6.67 per user per month billed annually or $8 billed monthly, and $10 per user per month billed annually or $12 billed monthly.
notable: Plans page says many organizations are eligible for a free Standard plan
Self-hosted software is 100% open source (plans page)

facts.fact: Zulip describes itself as an organized team chat app for distributed teams of all sizes.
The Zulip plans page says customers can sign up for a managed cloud solution or self-host its 100% open-source software.
The Zulip plans page lists paid Zulip Cloud plans at $6.67 per user per month billed annually or $8 billed monthly, and $10 per user per month billed annually or $12 billed monthly.
The Zulip homepage footer names Kandra Labs, Inc. as the owner of the Zulip name.
